stageA.sourceMathematics: Optional original Pattern Block Puzzles: construct a silhouette with FOUR actual blocks including at least ONE hexagon, exchange with a partner, find TWO distinct physical decompositions. Publisher Pattern Block Store PRICE TABLE is a source image, so exact shop prices cannot be invented.
stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Source learners calculate cost of two authentic FOUR-BLOCK puzzles and compare whether alternative same-outline construction is cheaper, with original publisher source table and sketch.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Teacher inspects real hexagon constraint, partner silhouettes, two valid decompositions and original price chart. Independent invented coin prices must be clearly labelled non-source.
